title: Newmark Represents Haworth in Relocation to California Market Center in Downtown Los Angeles
summary: Newmark announces the Company has represented Haworth, Inc., a global leader in workspace interiors and architectural solutions, in a long-term lease for approximately 14,586 square feet at the California Market Center (CMC).
body_markdown: Newmark announces the Company has represented Haworth, Inc., a global leader in workspace interiors and architectural solutions, in a long-term lease for approximately 14,586 square feet at the California Market Center (CMC).
